title: Two Years on, the Tonga Tsunami Shows Effective Risk Communication Saves Lives
organization: United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
temporal_coverage: Retrospective account of preparedness and response to the 15 January 2022 volcanic eruption and tsunami; follow-up reported in January 2024.
methodology: UNDRR retrospective using community and government accounts of warning and evacuation.
limitations: The event was volcanic and tsunami-related, not a climate-attributed hazard; the article is not an impact evaluation.
